name: bridge-architecture-yarn
description: Yarn-only Foundry-aware target validation after the Bridge Architecture extension. Named install allows fingerprint skip across attempts. Initializes Forge submodules (LayerZero, OZ, etc.) before compile. Uses next:lint + foundry:compile + next:build (root yarn lint hits known prettier noise in foundry scripts-js). Does not require Sepolia/Hedera RPC or live LayerZero for this gate.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install Next.js and Foundry workspaces with Yarn (pilot is yarn-only).

commands.name: submodules
commands.purpose: Fetch Foundry lib submodules required by LayerZero / OZ / Hedera forking (force fills empty checkouts).

commands.name: compile
commands.purpose: Compile Foundry LayerZero OFT / HTS connector contracts to confirm the Solidity workspace stays healthy.
